title: Fibre CI transport under principal localization
statement: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure, let $q\in\operatorname{Spec}S$, and let $g\in S\setminus q$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Fix a prime $q_1\in\operatorname{Spec}(S_g)$ whose contraction to $S$ is $q$. Put $p=q\cap R$, $p_1=q_1\cap R$, $F=\kappa(p)\otimes_R S$, $F_1=\kappa(p_1)\otimes_R S_g$, $Q=\ker(F\to\kappa(q))$, and $Q_1=\ker(F_1\to\kappa(q_1))$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. If there exists $h\in F\setminus Q$ for which $F_h$ is a global complete intersection over $\kappa(p)$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field], then there exists $h_1\in F_1\setminus Q_1$ for which $(F_1)_{h_1}$ is a global complete intersection over $\kappa(p_1)$.

proof.text: Contraction through the scalar tower gives p₁ = p. Transport the fibre neighbourhood hypothesis along this equality. Put k = κ(p), F = k ⊗_R S and a = 1 ⊗ g. Mathlib IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight identifies F₁ = k ⊗_R S_g with F_a as a k-algebra; its pure-tensor formula identifies the image of 1 ⊗ s with the localization of 1 ⊗ s.

Let Q₁ be the canonical fibre prime of q₁ and let Qg be its inverse image under the algebra equivalence F_a ≃ F₁. The inverse of PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber contracts along the right tensor inclusion. Contracting Qg further along F → F_a and then S → F gives q, by the pure-tensor formula and the given contraction q₁ ∩ S = q. Injectivity of the inverse fibre equivalence therefore gives Qg ∩ F = Q. For the witness h outside Q, the image b = h/1 is outside Qg; its image h₁ in F₁ is outside Q₁.

Put Fh = F_h. Mathlib IsLocalization.Away.mul and mul' make both (F_a)_{h/1} and (F_h)_{a/1} localizations of F away from ah. IsLocalization.algEquiv and restrictScalars identify them as k-algebras. Apply principal-localization stability to the given global complete intersection F_h. IsLocalization.algEquivOfAlgEquiv lifts F_a ≃ F₁ to the localizations at b and h₁. For both algebra-equivalence transports, use the existing private Algebra.globalCI_equiv from Sheaf.RingTheory.SmoothLocalCompleteIntersection, made available by a proof-only import all. This helper composes the presentation equivalence, transports Krull dimension by the induced spectrum homeomorphism, and preserves the zero-ring clause; the smooth-algebra theorem itself is not applied.

theorem exists_completeIntersection_fibre_transport
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) (g : S) (hg : g ∉ q.asIdeal)
    (q₁ : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away g))
    (hq : q₁.comap (algebraMap S (Localization.Away g)) = q)
    (hci : ∃ h : (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).Fiber S,
      h ∉ (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (q.comap (algebraMap R S))
        ⟨q, rfl⟩).asIdeal ∧
      IsGlobalCompleteIntersection (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).ResidueField
        (Localization.Away h)) :
    ∃ h : (q₁.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))).Fiber
          (Localization.Away g),
        h ∉ (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R (Localization.Away g)
          (q₁.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))) ⟨q₁, rfl⟩).asIdeal ∧
        IsGlobalCompleteIntersection
          (q₁.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))).ResidueField
          (Localization.Away h)
